sloka: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्।निहतानि जनस्थाने शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।। ६.९५.१४ ।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām।nihatāni janasthāne śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ ।। 6.95.14 ।।

translations.english: "On perceiving that Viradha solicitous of Vaidehi, the Rakshasa was killed by Rama with one arrow. That is sufficient proof (of Rama's valour)."
